summary: Spec axis: four blocking findings. Frozen identity matches. Independent static review only; parent owns the combined validation run. No source or tracker changes.

findings.requirement: Live updates preserve selection by record identity. Record removal displays an explanation and selects a nearby record or its parent.
findings.description: [INFERENCE from static control flow] Membership reconciliation runs only on the child-list screen. Move the selected child to Ungrouped while its detail is open, then press Esc. The old collection has no selected row, but Enter and actions still target that absent child.
findings.required_change: Reconcile collection membership for readers and action screens too. Restore a visible nearby child or its parent before return navigation.
findings.validation_scenario: Through SharedContextModal, open a child detail; reload a snapshot that moves that child to Ungrouped; press Esc, Enter and an action key. Check visible selection and canonical target.

findings.requirement: Live updates preserve selection by record identity.
findings.description: [INFERENCE from static control flow] Removing a remembered initiative always forces home. Open a queue without entering its selected ticket, then remove the previously remembered initiative. The surviving queue selection loses its view even though its canonical record remains.
findings.required_change: Apply initiative-removal navigation only when the current logical view depends on that initiative. Preserve unrelated queue state.
findings.validation_scenario: Load initiatives A and B; open All; select a surviving ticket in B without opening it; remove A; reload. The same queue, record and viewport must remain.

findings.requirement: At short heights, reduce decorative space and help text. Keep the selected row and essential navigation controls visible.
findings.description: [INFERENCE from static control flow] Viewport adjustment requires a changed selection reference. Inserting or expanding rows before the selected record keeps that reference unchanged, so the selected row can move entirely below the viewport. Resizing can cause the same failure.
findings.required_change: Reconcile the viewport when row layout changes, while preserving deliberate paging and canonical selection.
findings.validation_scenario: At 40x12 select a later initiative. Reload after inserting a wrapped initiative before it. Check that the original selected identity and its marker remain visible; also resize from 120x40.

findings.requirement: Long titles wrap beneath the title field. Status and count fields remain distinct. Narrow layouts move secondary information to another line.
findings.description: [INFERENCE from static rendering] Narrow rows put phase and Items on one unwrapped line. At 40 columns, a valid phase such as awaiting-maintainer-review pushes Items beyond the row width. Padding truncates the count permanently; paging cannot reveal it.
findings.required_change: Wrap phase and count independently, or put Items on its own subordinate line when both fields do not fit.
findings.validation_scenario: Render the complete modal at 40x12 with a recorded phase awaiting-maintainer-review and a nonzero count. Page through the row and check the full recorded phase and Items value.
